Rust struct with name, verify structure name contains value

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.treesitterlanguagepack.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var configJson = "{\"language\":\"rust\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("pub struct MyConfig {\n    pub name: String,\n    pub value: i32,\n}\n\nimpl MyConfig {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self { name: String::new(), value: 0 }\n    }\n}\n", config);
        System.out.println(result.language());
        System.out.println(result.structure());
    }
}
```
